svg.title: katana architecture: layers, modules and connections
svg.desc: Layer diagram of katana, with every connection labeled. Left stack, top to bottom: apps, UIOE (interpret, classify, route, retrieve, orchestrate, context builder, connectors), agent and tools, inference engine (tokenizer, model graph, grammar mask, sampler, KV and prefix cache, expert cache, cold-expert kernels, vision, EmbeddingGemma), data flows, hardware backends. Right column: code intelligence, codegen, image engine. Arrows carry: request, context block, tool calls and results, tokens, KV state, queries and evidence, brief and image, kernels. Status by color and marker shape: working, partial, planned, disabled.
svg.text: border: solid = built, dashed = planned, hatched = disabled; marker shape repeats the status
